{"has_issues": true, "issues": ["The memo states that Dril-Quip, Inc. changed its name to Innovex International, Inc. prior to the merger, yet also describes the merger as between 'Innovex and Dril-Quip'\u2014both cannot be true at the time of the merger if Dril-Quip no longer existed under that name.", "It identifies 'Innovex Downhole Solutions, LLC (formerly DQ Merger Sub, LLC),' implying Innovex Downhole Solutions did not exist pre-merger, while also characterizing the deal as a merger between 'Innovex' and Dril-Quip (implying Innovex was the pre-existing counterparty); these depictions conflict about which entity 'Innovex' was."]}
